numeric_semantics: Python arbitrary-precision integers; JavaScript BigInt for grid counts, prime products, rational ratings and order quantities. Other input numeric fields are safe integers.

assumptions.text: addListing adds one unit with seller, item and integer price. buy(item,budget) consumes the cheapest eligible listing, breaking equal-price ties by insertion order, and returns [seller,price] or null. Quantities, cancellation and order books are outside this inferred single-unit marketplace contract.
